summary.short: Luxembourg draft law (bill 8476, deposited 23 Dec 2024, in committee) to implement certain provisions of EU Regulation 2024/1689 (AI Act) and amend the 2018 CNPD law, the 1998 CSSF law and the 2015 insurance law. Operative provisions and dates are not in the fetched page.
summary.long: The bill, filed by Elisabeth Margue on 23 December 2024 and referred to the Commission des Médias et des Communications, is titled as a law implementing certain provisions of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (the AI Act) and amending three Luxembourg laws: the law of 1 August 2018 on the organisation of the Commission nationale pour la protection des données and the general data protection regime; the amended law of 23 December 1998 creating the Commission de surveillance du secteur financier; and the amended law of 7 December 2015 on the insurance sector. The dossier page records opinions from the CSSF, the CNPD, the Conseil d'État and other bodies, the last dated 10 July 2026, and a status of 'En commission'. The fetched page contains the title and dossier metadata only, not the bill's articles, so the scope of designations, obligations, penalties and entry-into-force dates is not described here. The registry stage 'introduced' is superseded by the dossier's committee stage.
